mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 1150 and retail sales above 470000 indicate robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1150 and RSAFS > 470000.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising by at least 0.25% over 3 months) increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increased by >= 0.25% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increased by >= 0.25% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 104.5 indicates strong manufacturing activity, supporting near-term corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 104.5.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index above 245 indicates elevated inflation expectations, triggering central bank tightening concerns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 245.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls above 146000 combined with unemployment below 4.5% signals a synchronized labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 146000 and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth of at least 0.5% over 3 months indicates capacity constraints, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increase >= 0.5% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increased by >= 0.5% over the prior 3 months.
